content.v: ■ 名古屋亚运会《王者荣耀》中国队卫冕金牌
9月28日，在爱知 · 名古屋亚运会电子竞技《王者荣耀》项目的决赛中，中国队以 4 比 0 击败马来西亚队，夺得金牌。
这是中国队继杭州亚运会之后再次夺得《王者荣耀》项目金牌。出场选手一诺（徐必成）成为全联盟首位、历史唯一一位双金牌得主。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/1246ac8e2b3d117b.png?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《三角洲行动》官宣日活突破5800万
10月8日，腾讯天美工作室群旗下《三角洲行动》项目组官宣，正值上线两周年之际，该游戏国服日活跃用户数已突破5800万。
去年9月，游戏一周年官宣DAU突破3000万，今年3月官宣突破5000万，这是几个月来再次刷新历史峰值，标志着《三角洲行动》已跻身腾讯长青游戏序列。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/3046ac8e546e0a3e.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 网易自研极限运动竞技射击游戏《极限战场》首曝
10月9日，网易游戏曝光极限运动竞技射击新游《极限战场》。该游戏以战术竞技为核心玩法，结合极限运动特征，玩家能够结合不同的战术装备在快速的战斗节奏中扭转战局、直到在决赛中争冠。
作为一款仍然以“吃鸡”为最终目标的游戏，《极限战场》不同于强调生存压力的同品类产品，希望通过移动、射击、角色战术装备、局内成长与团队配合，鼓励玩家主动创造战机。
游戏将于10月15日开始首轮测试。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/6196ac8e2b479a43.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 国产MMO《七界梦谭》三测开启
由拾异游戏开发的国产仙诡MMO游戏《七界梦谭》于10月9日正式开启“天上谣”三测。该测试开放PC端，可游玩内容包含仙门斗法、香火争夺、化形百变系统以及“逐鹿千戎”等竞技玩法。
此前，游戏就以独特的东方仙诡风格广受关注，此次测试在玩法和大世界探索方面更趋完善。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/4426ac8e2b435026.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 第二届RED LAND顺利举办，《星布谷地》线下参展
第二届RED LAND（小红书开放世界冒险岛）于2026年10月2日至6日落地上海杨浦区复兴岛。超100游戏IP参与此线下活动。《蛋仔派对》《逆水寒》《心动小镇》《无畏契约》《伊莫》《永劫无间》等多个广受欢迎的游戏在5天的花车巡游中登场，沿途设有角色互动、近距离饭撒和隐藏彩蛋等环节。
并且，米哈游《星布谷地》在RED LAND首次国内线下参展，旨在通过沉浸式线下体验推广生活模拟品类。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/3876ac8e37417a4b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 广州CICF×AGF大展顺利举办，多款重磅游戏首次线下试玩
广州CICF×AGF（中国国际漫画节动漫游戏展 × AGF玩出名堂游戏博览会）于 2026年10月2日至10月5日 在广州保利世贸博览馆成功举办。在4天的时间中，展会汇聚超过1000家海内外知名IP，举办超100场活动。
其中较为重磅的包括香港数码娱乐协会组织的“香港馆”，以及由近20款小游戏入驻试玩的“微信小游戏专区”。
值得关注的还有，备受期待的国产单机游戏《湮灭之潮》首次在国内的线下综合大展出现，供玩家试玩。此外，育碧《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》《魔法门之英雄无敌III重制版》、ANIPLEX《Fate/Extra Record》等重磅产品也在现场提供试玩。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/4296ac8e4aab6bbf.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 移动MMORPG颓势明显，区域市场衰落
DataEye发文称，移动MMORPG曾是营收最高的手游品类，如今它已跌至第六位，且下滑仍在继续。
SensorTower数据显示，2021年至2025年，MMORPG手游的IAP收入从53亿美元降至28亿美元，减少25亿美元，跌幅达到47%。至于下载量，移动MMORPG的下载量从2021年的3.45亿次下降至2025年的2.06亿次，跌幅达到40%。
分析表示，MMORPG式微的原因可能与东亚区域市场崩塌、玩家对传统玩法和付费疲劳、开放世界冒险RPG抬高行业门槛等多种原因有关。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/2636ac8e2b3b0f33.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 索尼新AI专利可根据玩家表现调整游戏NPC行为
近日，索尼互动娱乐（SIE）申请一项新专利，能以AI实际调整游戏NPC行为，让敌人能根据玩家的表现动态改变应对策略、对话与外观。
该专利于10月1日公布。该技术会先收集玩家资料与游戏资料，特别是玩家与敌人的战斗互动，并据此调整对方的行动。
这项专利可能会重点影响“魂”系游戏与动作游戏的体验。考虑到这类游戏多需要玩家“背板”，以此积累经验战胜Boss，当Boss的行为变得不可预测，战斗体验可能会更加激烈。同时，如果玩家攻击性极强，Boss也有可能提早进入更具危险性的二阶段等。
■ 草蜢工作室宣布脱离网易游戏，重新独立运营
9月30日，日本知名游戏工作室、《英雄不再》开发商草蜢工作室宣布正式脱离网易游戏，再度独立运营。该工作室由日本著名制作人须田刚一于1998年创立，作品个人风格强烈，往往与暴力、暗黑相关。
2021年，网易游戏收购草蜢工作室并支持其对主机游戏项目的开发，须田刚一继续担任CEO。今年2月，工作室推出新作《ROMEO IS A DEAD MAN（罗密欧是个绝命侠）》，这场“极致暴力的科幻盛宴”在Steam收获特别好评。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/1256ac8e373cd253.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
据须田刚一称，此次独立运营经与网易游戏和平协商后发生。经过数年历练，工作室已有更好的独立开发能力。
■ “3i计划”第四季游戏线上发布会举办，多款新品公开
10月8日晚，“3i计划”第四季游戏线上发布会正式举办。“3i计划”是众多独立游戏开发商组成的联盟组织，该发布会舍弃串场和商业广告，旨在将重点聚焦于游戏本身。
本次发布会上公布的重点作品包括，《Among Us》原版人马新作《Among Us Story: On Guard》，《机械迷城2》，《雨中冒险2》第四款DLC《万象归衡》，《塔罗斯法则3》等等。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-09/9126ac8e43e300cc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

news.title: 游戏主机价格飙升打击美国市场，分析师警告行业面临80年代初以来最大危机
news.summary: 市场调研机构 Circana 分析师马特·皮斯卡特拉发文警告称，美国游戏机硬件市场正面临自20世纪80年代初行业崩溃以来最严峻的危机。 数据显示，今年截至8月，美国市场的 Xbox 硬件销量同比下降33%，创下历史新低。

content.v: 市场调研机构 Circana 分析师马特·皮斯卡特拉发文警告称，美国游戏机硬件市场正面临自20世纪80年代初行业崩溃以来最严峻的危机。 数据显示，今年截至8月，美国市场的 Xbox 硬件销量同比下降33%，创下历史新低。同期 PlayStation 硬件销量下降25%，降至2013年以来的最低点。
https://image.gcores.com/18f18721c4cb830e8fa7c236191d98c1-570-321.webp

当然，价格上涨是销量下滑的主因。受人工智能数据中心对内存组件的大量需求影响，PlayStation 和 Xbox 等主流游戏机在多数市场的售价持续走高。今年前8个月，美国消费者购买一台新 Xbox 的平均价格为529美元，比去年同期上涨26%。购买一台新 PlayStation 的平均价格为597美元，同比上涨20%。这两项数据均创下美国市场历史新高，凸显出严重的市场价格敏感问题。 同时，业内则寄希望于下个月发售的大作《侠盗猎车手6》能拉动主机销量。皮斯卡特拉认为，这款游戏或许能缓解部分销量跌幅，但前提是产品供应必须充足。如果内存芯片持续被AI数据中心占用，微软和索尼将无法生产足够的主机来满足市场需求。 受内存短缺影响的不只是游戏机，各类消费电子产品的价格近年来均普遍上涨。美光科技首席执行官此前警告称，内存短缺预计将持续到2028年。微软游戏业务负责人阿莎·夏尔玛也透露，主机存储组件的采购成本在过去两年内已飙升至原来的5倍以上，且预计在2027年假期到来前还将进一步显著上涨。

news.title: 万智牌《漫威：黑暗要塞命运》预购现已上线
news.summary: Grab Play Boosters, Bundles, Commander Precons and more from Marvel's upcoming Darkhold Destiny set, launching

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/marvel-darkhold-destiny-ign-preorders-1791557688289.png
Magic: The Gathering's next Marvel crossover set has been revealed , as Wizards of the Coast announced that "Marvel: Darkhold Destiny" will launch on April 9, 2027.
Preorders are now available via local game stores, TCGplayer , Amazon , and other retailers. I'll leave links to where you can buy everything just below.

"The world's greatest sorcerers conspired to keep the Darkhold sealed," Wizards of the Coast (WOTC) said in its announcement, as part of New York Comic Con. "But the dark side of the Marvel Universe has been unleashed!"
It also teased the arrival of "devils, sorcerers, and vampire-hunting vampires" in the upcoming set, which will of course explore the supernatural side of Marvel.

An original story has been developed for the new set, with WOTC developing in collaboration with Marvel, which will also introduce a brand-new original character. The story will also be adapted into a special Marvel Comics release, written by Jackson Lanzing and Collin Kelly.
"This story was crafted by our Narrative team with Magic in mind, and we're thrilled to see it adapted by two of Marvel's most beloved writers," added WOTC.
"You'll be able to follow this dimension-hopping narrative across the set, all while uncovering the secrets of the Dark Dimension and joining forces with Marvel's pantheon of gods."
The comic is due to arrive in February 2027 in digital format, followed by a physical release in April.
Magik, a mutant sorceress who many fans will also recognize from Marvel Rivals ' roster, or more recently Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls , is the only hero confirmed for the set so far.
But WOTC has also said that the expansion will feature plenty more "hotly anticipated" Marvel heroes and villains making their MTG debuts.
Marvel: Darkhold Destiny will include the main card set, Commander decks, Scene Boxes, and special collector-focused card designs.
The Commander precon options this time around are Lords of Hel (red-black), Gods of Asgard (red-green-white), Strange Academy (white-blue-black) and Midnight Sons (white-black).

WOTC says it has also developed new "Booster Fun treatments" for the expansion, alongside updated versions of designs used in previous releases, "so collectors of everything Marvel will have plenty to get excited for".

Darkhold Destiny is one of the latest collaborations between Marvel and Magic: The Gathering, which has been increasingly drawing established entertainment franchises to the TCG through its Universes Beyond range.
In 2025, we saw the Marvel Spider-Man set , and in 2026, we got the Marvel Super Heroes expansion as well.
Now in 2027, Darkhold Destiny continues the longstanding collaboration between the entertainment giants.

news.summary: 株式会社SNK宣布，在好评发售中的对战格斗游戏《饿狼传说：群狼之城》中，将与 Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. 的人气对战格斗游戏《铁拳》系列进行联动，作为第3季第6弹DLC角色上线《铁拳8

content.v: 株式会社SNK宣布，在好评发售中的对战格斗游戏《饿狼传说：群狼之城》中，将与 Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. 的人气对战格斗游戏《铁拳》系列进行联动，作为第3季第6弹DLC角色上线《铁拳8》的人气角色“丽奈”。
作为《铁拳》系列新世代人气角色的丽奈，将参与以南镇为舞台展开的新战斗。这不仅是《铁拳》粉丝的盛宴，也是《饿狼传说：群狼之城》玩家们可以畅享的、格斗游戏粉丝必看的特别联动合作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261010/1791602835_893792_jpg_r.jpg
>“饿狼传说：群狼之城” x “铁拳 丽奈” 先行预告短片
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261010/1791602835_757713_jpg_r.jpg
在第3季中，以“背负复仇命运者”为概念，瑞克·斯托德、达克·金、金家藩等往年人气角色将参战。此外，在10月的DLC角色第4弹中，将会同时上线佐野万次郎(Mikey)和龙宫寺坚(Draken)两名角色，11月将会上线拉奥。
作为第3季的收官，今日也正式宣布了来自《铁拳》的丽奈即将在12月加入战斗。第3季将总共新增7个DLC角色。
“饥饿的狼先生们，终于可以过过招了吧?”
来自世界知名对战格斗游戏《铁拳》系列的神秘少女丽奈，将加入《饿狼传说：群狼之城》。丽奈首次登场于《铁拳8》，深受全球玩家喜爱。她天真烂漫的笑容背后隐藏着压倒性的实力和冷酷无情，她将在南镇迎战新的强敌。《铁拳》独有的快速且激进的战斗风格与《饿狼传说：群狼之城》的REV系统相融合。玩家将可以享受到兼具两大系列魅力的刺激游戏体验。
丽奈 | REINA
声优 [日语]濑户麻沙美 [英语]Kate Clarke
除了知道她三岛工业高等专门学校的学生之外，丽奈的身份完全是个谜。这位神秘的少女在战斗中，偶尔会在电光火石般的动作中展现出隐藏的凶暴性。她漫无目的地访问了南镇，随后决定参加拳皇大赛。
在她行动的背后，真正意图到底是……?
《铁拳》系列简介
Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. 于1994年诞生的3D对战格斗游戏系列。以个性丰富的角色们构成的宏大剧情和可以享受高度策略性的游戏系统，持续吸引着全世界的粉丝。系列累计销售量超过6,100万本，在电子竞技场景中也拥有极高的人气。最新作《铁拳8》采用了Unreal Engine 5，导入了全新的战斗系统“热力系统”，开创了系列的新纪元。
此外，在《铁拳7》中，《饿狼传说》系列的人气角色吉斯·霍华德作为嘉宾角色参战，令两大系列的粉丝们为之狂热。这次丽奈的参战，是继承了这一缘分，实现了梦幻般的跨界合作。
《饿狼传说：群狼之城》是一款什么样的游戏?
《饿狼传说：群狼之城》是一款最新的格斗游戏，兼具了任何人都能享受的爽快操作性和随着游戏深入而扩展的策略深度。它继承了系列特有的魅力，同时还搭载了独特的艺术风格、新的战斗系统“REV”、单人RPG模式“EOST”等众多易于上手的元素，适合初次接触的玩家。
此外，我们彻底追求适合初学者的操作风格，以及通过跨平台联机/回滚方式带来的舒适在线对战。
第3季中，除了新角色外，还计划每月持续发布新的关卡和各种游戏内内容。发售后也将通过定期的内容更新，促进玩家社区的活跃和提升游戏品牌的长期价值。

news.summary: Konami 制作人冈本基在接受《Fami 通》采访时透露，Konami 计划推出“第二波和第三波”《寂静岭》新作。 他在采访中表示：“我们最初公布的三款游戏都成功发售了，让我们松了一口气（笑）。它们收获了很好的评价，对

others.title: Konami 正在规划新《寂静岭》游戏的“第二波和第三波”

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/05/27/untitled-1-copy-1666187781885-1716851975081.jpg
Konami is planning "second and third waves" of new Silent Hill games, according to producer Motoi Okamoto.

Okamoto offered a foggy glimpse into the classic horror franchise's future during an interview featured in Famitsu Issue 1965 (via Game Observer ). The series ended a long, painful drought without new games with an initial wave of new releases over the last few years, and now that this first batch is out, Konami is already looking forward to what it can do next.
"All three titles we initially announced were able to be released successfully, so we’re relieved (laughs)," he noted. "They’ve also received high praise, and we are satisfied with it."

Okamoto continued: "Successfully launching this 'first wave' comes with great relief, but we’re not stopping here; we must think of the second and third waves. We can’t share specific details, but we’re currently looking at a number of projects."

The first wave of Konami's return to Silent Hill – which included titles like the Silent Hill 2 remake , Silent Hill f , and last month's Silent Hill: Townfall – rolled out throughout the last few years. Townfall arrived as the most recent installment when it dropped players into the shoes of protagonist Simon Ordell in a '90s Scotland just last month.

It received generally favorable reviews, with IGN giving it an 8/10 . We said, "Like the intravenous needle permanently jutting out of its hero’s wrist, Silent Hill: Townfall gives this long running series a welcome shot in the arm."

It's a successful run of games that Konami is happy with, but getting here wasn't easy. After Hideo Kojima's Silent Hills failed to materialize, Okamoto said he had a hard time convincing higher-ups that more games was the way to go. However, as far as he was concerned, "just one remake is not enough," adding, "as a producer, I cannot let it end only with that."
"If there were only one release, wouldn’t people think that the development is going to be cancelled again, I thought," Okamoto added.

While Konami's plan to launch additional waves of Silent Hill games spells a promising future for fans who have missed the franchise, we have known that the series would continue in some form. Bloober Team, the horror-centric developer responsible for the Silent Hill 2 remake, confirmed it was working on a remake of the original Silent Hill last year.

news.title: 《Tokyo Stories》制作人采访：描绘存在于记忆中的东京

content.v: 由Drecom Co开发、Happinet发行的像素风冒险游戏《Tokyo Stories》在TGS 2026期间提供了试玩。本作描绘了一座人们不知为何消失、只剩下城市痕迹的东京。玩家将跟随主角凉，在空无一人的街道中探索，通过场景、声音、文字与解谜，逐渐了解她的心情，以及她对优乃的思念。
本作最大的特色之一，是将像素艺术与3D场景相结合，并采用固定镜头来呈现这座寂静的城市。我们在体验TGS试玩版后，通过邮件采访了本作制作人池田佑基，请他进一步介绍游戏的视觉表现、叙事设计，以及从《rain》到《Tokyo Stories》的创作变化。
采访详情如下：
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104700-9806-68262.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——东京和涩谷在很多人的印象里是热闹繁华的，但本作却描绘了一座空荡的城市。开发团队想要通过它传递怎样的情绪？
A：提到涩谷，大家印象中往往是热闹繁华的街区，但实际走一走就会发现，只要从人流拥挤的大道拐进一条小巷，就会突然遇到四下无人的瞬间。本作想描绘的，正是那种时刻感受到的、有些不可思议的寂静，以及恍然间被城市遗落在旁的感觉。
因为没有人，平日里被忽略的空调外机、海报、窗户里透出的灯光这些东西就会映入眼帘。我希望这能成为一种体验：玩家通过这些城市的痕迹，自然而然地开始在意本应存在于那里的某个人，以及凉自己的心情。希望大家感受到的不只是一座寂寞的城市，还能从中品出几分怀念。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104658-6001-81513.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——在试玩TGS的试玩版本时，本作给我传递出的情感更多来自氛围而不是故事。请问开发团队在开发时是更注重故事本身，还是注重用游戏传递这种氛围？
A：与其说侧重哪一方，不如说我们对两者同样重视。TGS试玩版截取的是开头部分，是故事尚未正式展开的阶段，所以氛围的印象才格外强烈。
开头我们特意安排了缓慢行走的时光，希望玩家也能感受到凉起伏不定的心情，以及她对优乃的思念。包括街道的视觉与声音、镜头切换在内，我们把氛围本身设计成了传达故事的一部分。正式版中盘之后，故事会不断向前推进，也请大家期待。
——我在试玩过程中看到了一些相当轻度的解谜要素，这些部分会对本作的游戏性有多大影响，还是说它们更多地只是叙事的一部分？
A：解谜并不是与故事割裂的存在，在设计时会留意不脱离故事和场景。我们没有设固定统一的推进模式，而是针对每个地点仔细自考并配置合适的玩法，所以既有以探索为主的场景，也有以解谜为主的场景，还有什么都不做只是独自在街上游荡的场景。
试玩版因为是开头部分，"游戏感"强的内容比较少，但正式版中除了解谜和探索，还有角色之间的对话和事件等，每个场景都有各种不同的玩法。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104659-6686-29089.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——游戏中存在不少对话选项和可收集的关键词，请问选择不同的选项或是关键词的收集度是否会影响故事发展？正式版又是否存在多个结局？
A：本作没有重大剧情分支，结局也只有一个。
选项与其说是用来划分故事的，不如说是为了让玩家更容易理解凉在想什么、为什么而犹豫的一种设计。人在把心情化作语言时，会考虑各种细节——用什么措辞、怎么说才不会被误解，对吧。在选择选项的场景中，我们把这些思考以可读取的文字显示在周围，让玩家得以贴近角色的心情。关键词也一样，是作为更深入地了解凉、优乃和这座东京的要素来设计的。
——本作独特的叙事方式是否有受到一些作品的影响？请大致分享一下相关的作品。
A：与其说参考了某部特定作品，不如说受十几岁时玩的那些PS1游戏影响更大。第一次玩PC版《鬼屋魔影》时，那种固定镜头营造出的临场感，至今仍记忆犹新。
故事的推进方式上，我们尽量不设固定套路，而是把想讲的故事、想展示的场景串联起来，在合适的地方放上合适的玩法。从这个意义上说，过去制作《rain》的经验也产生了很大影响。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104658-3135-21243.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——在开发本作期间，是故事的写作更难，还是技术上的实现更难？制作组又是如何克服的？
A：两者都很辛苦，不过技术方面在Blender的反复试错中较早看清了表现的方向，反倒是"故事与玩法如何衔接"才是我一直烦恼的部分。本作为每个场景设定了不同的玩法，虽然不会沦为重复劳动，但制作量不可避免地增加了。
与其说已经跨过难关，不如说还在跨越的途中。我做游戏差不多20年了，游戏开发真的很辛苦。即便如此，能和团队一起乐在其中地开发，已是万幸。
——相比创造一个完全虚构的城市，本作选择了现实中的东京。对于团队来说，真实存在的东京和游戏中的“Tokyo Stories”之间，最大的区别是什么？
A：最大的不同在于，游戏里的东京并不是"原封不动截取当下的东京"。初中时代憧憬的涩谷、工作后夜晚去玩的涩谷、长大成人后渐渐少去的闹市——我们把身为制作者的这些记忆碎片组合起来，构筑了这座城市。
建筑和场景道具虽然有参考的地方，但没有一处是照搬还原的，还有很多是从零开始设计的。另外，我们刻意回避了近年涩谷那些充满未来感的街景，描绘的是不起眼的小巷、随处可见的台阶这样的地方。因此，这座城市没有过度偏向某个特定时代，也许更像是存在于某个人记忆中的东京。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104659-7994-16296.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——《Tokyo Stories》最大的视觉特色就是将像素艺术与3D结合在一起，为什么团队最终选择了这种表现方式？如果单纯使用3D或像素，反而无法表现出本作想要的东京吗？
A：像素画这种能唤起观者想象力的表现形式，我一直心向往之，但我想做的不是沿袭FC、SFC时代的表现，而是开创一种新的像素画形态。
纯粹的2D像素画，要大量制作变更镜头角度的场景非常费力，很难做出我们想要的体量。而另一方面，用纯粹的3D描绘东京，呈现的信息量会过多，不可避免地变成一座司空见惯的东京。
我们的团队3D技术很强，通过把3D制作的空间转化为像素画，既保留了将信息凝练于色彩与剪影的观感，又能制作各种运镜的场景。多亏这种组合，我们终于接近了一直想要描绘的那座东京。
——现在的3D冒险游戏通常会让玩家自由控制镜头，但《Tokyo Stories》依然采用了固定镜头。对于本作来说，固定镜头除了视觉表现之外，在游戏设计上还有什么意义？
A：固定镜头是PS1时代常见的手法，我自己也记得，当时曾为那种以往游戏所没有的、经过演出设计的临场感而惊叹。《rain》也采用了这一手法，是我们情有独钟的表现方式。
从游戏设计的角度来说，正因为镜头不能自由移动，才会催生"画面之外、小巷深处有什么"的好奇与想象。而且玩家是以稍远的距离注视着凉，与其说是自己成为主角，不如说形成了陪伴一个女孩的故事的距离感。对制作者来说，能够针对每个场景决定要展示什么、把画面设计成一幅完整的画作，这点也非常重要。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104657-3127-25652.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——在展台试玩时也询问过您，您当时明确表示本作不会加入人物语音。请问这是出于怎样的考虑？
A：最大的原因，是想留下让玩家按自己的节奏阅读文本、去想象角色心情的余白。在选项场景中，我们采用了把凉选词时的犹豫和想法以文字形式显示在周围的演出，我想珍视这种只有文本才能实现的表现。
另外，像素画的角色是刻意压缩了表情信息量的，所以我觉得不加配音，反而能让角色形象在每位观者心中自然地丰满起来。
不过，我们也一直憧憬着配音，今后想找机会尝试。
——从《rain》到《Tokyo Stories》，已经过去了十多年。如果让您自己总结，这十多年间最大的变化是什么？哪些东西反而一直没有改变？
A：最大的变化，是变得能够刻画角色了。《rain》的主角是一个看不见身形、没有台词的角色，而《Tokyo Stories》中我们挑战了现代化的角色设计，角色之间也有正常的对话。参与过各种IP的游戏制作、接触过大量内容之后自然而然发生的转变——我有这样的实感。
另外，当年我们很向往海外，但随着年岁渐长，目光转而投向了自己的根之所在的东京，这也是变化之一。
不变的大概是十几岁时沉迷PS1游戏的那份心情吧。行业的状况在这十年间发生了巨变，但创作终究是随着个人的情感与喜好推进的，我想我们一直在追赶的，正是当年憧憬过的那些游戏作品的背影。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1010/20261010104657-8289-31429.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
——有不少玩家都在期待本作发售，但游戏目前还没有公开发售日期。请用百分比来形容一下游戏当前的开发进度。
A：虽然很难用数字来表述，但游戏的骨架已经成形，现在正进入提升各个场景品质的阶段。Happinet作为发行商、Character Bank作为开发协作方加入后，开发推进顺利了很多。包括发售日在内，请大家期待今后的消息。

news.title: 北京核聚变，来Hit Academy试玩多款学生游戏！
news.summary: 核聚变游戏嘉年华北京站即将开幕，热门新游试玩、精彩舞台活动、限定周边收集、沉浸式体验最热烈的玩家氛围！10 月 24、25 日，我们首钢国际会展中心见！ <获取2026北京核聚变门票> GGG游戏节奏联欢夜为北京核聚变游

content.v: 核聚变游戏嘉年华北京站即将开幕，热门新游试玩、精彩舞台活动、限定周边收集、沉浸式体验最热烈的玩家氛围！10 月 24、25 日，我们首钢国际会展中心见！
GGG游戏节奏联欢夜为北京核聚变游戏嘉年华期间举办的夜间音乐演出活动，如需购买GGG核聚变联票，请前往GGG购票页面。
https://image.gcores.com/1d26bbe5a7ecd0a9d77bcc050ada1e5c-966-366.png
10 月 24 日-25 日，HitAcademy将携 15 款学生游戏亮相核聚变游戏嘉年华 2026 北京站【B12】！
HitAcademy一直致力于为热爱游戏创作的学生提供系统化、专业化的游戏设计教育，也希望让更多玩家看到年轻开发者们真实而大胆的创意表达。
来到现场，当然要亲自上手试试！
策略玩法可以怎么搭出意想不到的套路？解谜关卡藏着什么样的巧思？平台跳跃又能不能挑战你的操作极限？这里有多款充满想法的学生原创游戏，等你一一体验！
游戏介绍
《玩个Gui2：天脊之下》
https://image.gcores.com/8106b6b9ac4061aae9ecb3ec107b9bb6-966-543.png
《玩个Gui2：天脊之下》是一款Roguelike类的策略游戏。在前作《玩个gui》“移动塔防”的创新玩法基础上，本作加入了更多富有挑战的关卡设计。您不仅需要精心规划错综复杂的轨道网络，部署并强化您独一无二的“战斗列车”，更要利用“炮塔附魔”等全新系统，为您的移动堡垒赋予毁灭性的能力。每一次布局都是智慧的博弈，每一次调整都关乎防线的存亡。
《神代之烬》
https://image.gcores.com/e570c6d7d9ee69400ec827448fc8edc7-966-543.png
《神代之烬》以古罗马神话为背景，玩家化身“烬火”重燃神代力量。核心为策略战棋玩法，通过符文石板操控主角行动以进行回合制战斗，强调资源管理与路径规划，带来策略博弈与编程行动的新颖体验。
《代号：大娘》
https://image.gcores.com/865e82e51ddfec94b5e9e94478a736a9-966-543.png
安史之乱撕裂了大唐。 你是一缕意识，附在一代剑舞大家公孙大娘的剑锋之上。她从江南到长安，追寻那个远去的帝王。 俯视战场，规划一条贯穿所有敌人的路线，她会沿着这条线弹射穿梭，一击斩杀所有挡路的人。 沿途遇见李白、杜甫、张旭、吴道子……故人重逢，也生死与共。 你替她看路，她替你出剑。史书合上了，她还在走。
《破损核心》
https://image.gcores.com/1d4a060706e041224efba0b096fecc1a-966-543.png
《破损核心》是一款肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。在未来的某一天，我们的垃圾回收机器人因意外导致能量核心被毁。你需要帮助它收集各种各样的垃圾，并利用能量回收机破坏这些垃圾，从中获取足够多的能量。帮助机器人修复它的能量核心。
《病毒》
https://image.gcores.com/e59b4ab2d813605870cac83614c82e4a-966-543.png
以真实的电脑桌面环境为背景，在混乱的病毒入侵场景下，用直观真实的操作逻辑抵御病毒的紧张操作体验。
《丰收牌局》
https://image.gcores.com/8bcf7c058788d9bdfc88b3f448e8ae9b-966-543.png
这是一款需要你亲手劳作的卡牌构筑种田游戏。在每季有限的回合与田地里，你要合理播种各类作物，巧妙运用各种机制，培育出高产的作物。从镰刀到收割机，收获的每个环节都由你亲手完成。构筑最强牌组，成为受人尊敬的农场主吧！
《挤猫猫》
https://image.gcores.com/297bed831217614852fe6db0fa747d92-966-543.png
推箱挪位，钻管探路，锁定爆破点，轰开迷宫暗墙！小猫 Coco 为无穷小鱼干勇闯猫神试炼，在手绘清新关卡里，邂逅温柔又烧脑的治愈谜题。小老鼠伙伴会一路吱吱提醒，伴你前行。
《引力子》
https://image.gcores.com/8aaa61dd4d91f973171ac81e2445e86a-966-480.png
掌控重力，破解这款 2D 平台解谜游戏的谜题！化身科学家，探索黑洞附近的废弃空间站，揭开它的过往，发掘未知物理法则下的世界运转之道。反重力、反物质、磁场等机制颠覆常规逻辑 —— 你的物理直觉就是通关关键。
《阿比亚：弹射之旅》
https://image.gcores.com/a24b830cb1641540ede9f47376da27d0-966-543.png
《阿比亚:弹射之旅》是一款平台动作游戏。您将扮演机器人阿比亚从末世废墟的地底醒来，一路跳跃、攀爬、射击，在危机四伏的地下世界里寻找真相。在风格迥异的区域中，您还会遇到不同势力的角色，在不断地深入探索中，终将发现这个世界的秘密。
《小小秦棋攻略》
https://image.gcores.com/f4d22f118c1231cd937697e29ae9aa33-966-543.png
这是一个结合了肉鸽要素的带有塔防体验的抽象棋类游戏，玩家必须依照直接或间接连接到主帅的方式，打出自己子库的棋子。当自己的棋子打入到对方的底线累计X分就获得胜利。
在游戏过程中玩家需要通过规划和连接自己不同的棋子来达成联合防御和破坏对方胜利的目的。
《从万事屋开始的冒险者公会》
https://image.gcores.com/da6f3bc2c380e8aa1f2e5cef355d005f-966-543.png
《从万事屋开始的冒险者公会》是一款日式西幻题材的模拟经营游戏。玩家将扮演失去记忆的精灵，从经营一间小小的万事屋开始，接待委托、结识形形色色的冒险者，在一次次判断与选择中解决小镇的问题，并逐渐将万事屋发展为真正的冒险者公会。
《Ghost out of the Shell》
“这是一个被圣剑选中的勇者的故事，但你并不是故事的主角。”
《Ghost out of the Shell》是一块俯视角潜行冒险游戏，在故事中，你不再是拯救世界的勇者，而是一个被勇者抛弃的本应操控他的幽灵。尽管失去了躯壳，但你也因此获得了附身故事中其他角色的能力，通过这一能力，你踏上了追寻勇者并尝试重新控制它的冒险。
《夜幕档案》
夜幕落下，档案室的门在你身后关上。门外的这条街上，有人撒谎，有人伪装，还有人胡言乱语。你的任务，就是从字里行间找出那个经不起推敲的瞬间。“排除所有不可能，剩下的无论多么不可思议，那都是真相。”
《平面设计 101》
你是一名毕业即失业的大学生，意外进入了一家平面设计公司。你将会遇到各种各样的设计要求和奇怪的甲方。根据甲方要求，运用各种设计工具和你高超的平面设计能力，在一次次尝试中摸索甲方的要求喜好。只要关键部分达成要求，剩余的画面就完全由你掌控。设计出完美的作品，完成挑战吧！
《刺球》
化身灵活又倔强的刺球，在险峻高塔间翻滚前进，伸缩双腿寻找支点、积蓄力量，一跃跨越机关与深渊。这里没有轻松的捷径，每次失误都可能让你跌回谷底；但只要稳住节奏、掌握惯性，下一次起跳，便可能抵达从未见过的高度！
当然，现场还有集章打卡、互动抽奖以及周边小礼品等你来解锁~
这个 10 月，欢迎来到Hit Academy【B12】展位，试玩游戏、参与互动，说不定就能发现你的“下一款上头游戏”！

news.title: 万智牌回归漫威，推出《黑暗堡垒命运》
news.summary: Magic the Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Supe

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/mdd-1-1791498129253.jpg

Magic: The Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Super Heroes set last year. But for its third Marvel set, MTG is getting spooky with Darkhold Destiny.

Rather than being based in a fairly mundane version of New York, Darkhold Destiny is taking the likes of Doctor Strange and the Asgardians and telling a more magical story (forgive me). What really separates this new out-there set from the other two Marvel sets is that Wizards of the Coast was really able to write its own story with Marvel's characters and settings, which makes them feel less like a crossover and more like a part of Magic's multiverse.

With a new story written in-house, Wizards of the Coast was also able to give its artists more license to create their own takes on Marvel characters. For instance, with Scarlet Witch in the Marvel Super Heroes set, she looks like a pretty standard take on her comic book appearance. But in the art I was shown for Darkhold Destiny, she looks much more like an MTG character, while still retaining some of the signature parts of her outfit – the mask is still there.

I was also given broad strokes of what the story is about. Essentially, Dormammu and Hela use the Darkhold to invade the entire multiverse, and it's up to Doctor Strange, Thor, and other Marvel heroes to stop them. Of course, because of the characters and, well, props that the story revolves around, the set is focused heavily on spellcasting.

Thematically, the spellcasting is focused on what's essentially three different 'schools' of magic: Arcane, Divine, and Dark. Arcane magic will be themed around Doctor Strange and his allies, while Divine magic will be wielded by the Asgardians and other similar... entities. Dark magic is primarily going to be wielded by the villains of the set, but there are some heroes, like Ghost Rider that will apparently be wielding Dark magic.

You can expect a lot of focus on cool instants, sorceries and 'unique enchantments.' Wizards is even bringing back the Arcane subtype on instants and sorceries, which hasn't been used since Saviors of Kamigawa all the way back in 2005. I even asked if WotC is bringing back the obscure 'Splice Onto Arcane' ability that let you combine different arcane spells, but sadly, it is not.

Just like any other recent set, there will be a whole lineup of different Darkhold Destiny products. The standard fare is all here, Booster Packs, Collector Boosters and Bundles; but there will also be four commander decks.

Each of these commander decks will also have a collector's edition available, which will be completely decked out in foils. There will also be two scene boxes, each with six mechanically unique cards. Both the Bundle and the special Gift Bundle will also come with a mechanically unique promo card, and I just hope they don't skyrocket immediately on TCGPlayer, but I know that they probably will.

Wizards of the Coast will be giving the first glimpse of its original Marvel story in February with a comic produced alongside Image comics. Then, another comic will come out closer to when the set launches in April 2027.

news.summary: Today at New York Comic Con, Wizards of the Coast announced the first 2027 Universes Beyond expansion set for

content.v: Today at New York Comic Con, Wizards of the Coast announced the first 2027 Universes Beyond expansion set for Magic: The Gathering. Marvel’s Darkhold Destiny will pit Doctor Strange, Thor, Ghost Rider, and more against cosmic villains like Hela and Dormammu in 2027.

The set will include normal and Collector booster packs, and four pre-constructed commander decks themed around Marvel heroes and villains, including the Midnight Sons. Multiple cards were shown during the hour-long panel, including Magic, who transforms into Darkchild, Gargantos, and the titular Darkhold.

Darkhold Destiny tells an original story co-created by designers at Marvel and Wizards of the Coast. Along with that story, a brand-new character created for this set will be introduced in a Marvel Infinity comic series starting in February.

news.title: 《狂热运输3》简评：自成一派的交通运输模拟佳作
news.summary: 运输对游戏世界的影响是真实而有力的。

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/10/head-3863QB-banner1.jpg
独立游戏领域不乏数十年如一日坚持开发同类型游戏的工作室，在交通运输模拟品类中，扮演这一角色的是创立于 2013 年的瑞士独立工作室 Urban Games。这家工作室于成立次年推出了首部作品《狂热火车》（Train Fever），玩家将从第一次工业革命完成后的 19 世纪中叶起步，体验 19、20 世纪的城镇内公共交通线路和城镇间铁路的运营乐趣。

作为工作室首作，尽管《狂热火车》在诸多方面的表现略显粗糙，但已经展露出极大的拓展潜力。2016 年，Urban Games 推出了《狂热运输》（Transport Fever），其时间背景和前作相似，但在该作中，玩家可以通过构建公路、铁路、水上和空中的立体交通网，建设一个真正意义上的运输帝国，《狂热运输》也由此成为了该品类的代表作之一。此后，工作室围绕着“全面、拟真的交通运输模拟”这一概念持续深耕，2019 年，系列续作《狂热运输 2》（Transport Fever 2）发售，这一次，玩家将运营来自欧洲、亚洲和美国的超过 200 种交通工具，踏上一场横跨三个大洲的冒险。
今年 9 月 30 日，系列最新作 《狂热运输 3》 （Transport Fever 3）正式上线。本作虽然没有在前作基础上做出颠覆性改动，但众多新机制的加入有望使其进一步巩固《狂热运输》系列在交通运输模拟领域的位置。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-13468sx.jpg

从《狂热火车》开始，Urban Games 就打造了一套简单、直观的交互逻辑。游戏中的城镇分为居住区、商业区和工业区，居民会定期往返于三个区域，商业区和工业区需要货物供给，为此玩家需要设定线路以满足客运和货运需求。建设交通线路的过程十分简便：设定公交车站只需在指定位置按下鼠标，规划铁道线路只需从起点开始拖动鼠标绘制。在我看来，它或许是一款既能玩得简单，也能玩得“复杂”的游戏：你可以追求快速组建运输网，也可以通过点击城镇内每个居民的个人面板，查看其行动轨迹，设计出尽可能高效的交通线路。
上述底层逻辑也被《狂热运输》系列所沿用，系列中，每局游戏的核心目标同样是依靠客运和货运盈利，不断扩张城镇和运输网络规模。游戏分自由和战役两大模式，初始设定完毕后进入自由模式，新手教程会逐步介绍核心玩法，玩家要做的基本上是修建道路、建设车库、购置载具以及设定交通线路，最后将载具分配至指定线路即可。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-23494iY.jpg

另一方面，Urban Games 也持续致力于丰富《狂热运输》系列的游戏机制。《狂热运输 3》中，交通线路正常运转起来并不会万事大吉，玩家还需要关注城镇供应水平、噪音程度、污染程度以及拥堵程度等 8 个指标：如果货运列车速度较慢，或仓库贮藏不当，进而导致运至城镇的食物变质，便会极大影响居民的幸福感；若是交通线路上运营的载具数量不足，致使居民出行等车时间过长，数据面板上居民怒气冲冲的表情也会给玩家敲响警钟；若是道路没有及时进行防噪音改造，沿线居民......总之，想把各指标同时维持在良好状态并非易事。当指标状态均保持正常，城镇人口便会快速增长，进而提升城镇等级，让游戏世界走向繁荣。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-33509bk.jpg
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-43519ir.jpg
除了城镇指标和等级机制以外，《狂热运输 3》还新加入了职业等级设定。本作中，玩家可以提升自己角色的职业等级，还能在城镇中建设公司总部，总部能为城镇提供 5%的增长加成。随着职业等级的提升，将逐步解锁新的总部附属建筑，进而提供更多增益。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-17915435599343559G8.jpg
说起《狂热运输》系列，不得不提的部分就是模组，从初代开始，开发团队就重视维护与模组开发者的良好合作关系。到了《狂热运输 3》，游戏内置的模组中心取代了创意工坊，得益于模组社群的早期参与，本作发售伊始，模组中心便为玩家提供了丰富的可拓展选择，并且还在持续扩充。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-53539gz.jpg
自初代《狂热运输》开始，战役模式就是系列的重要玩法之一：开发团队选取了人类交通运输史上的若干重要工程，让玩家领导其建设工作。美中不足的是，初代战役只集中在欧洲和美国两个地区，局限性较为明显。这一点在《狂热运输 2》中有了很大改善，战役发生的年代和地域都得到了拓展，两个中国背景关卡（一是建设新中国历史上的第一条铁路成渝铁路，二是建设 2010 年上海的交通网络）更是广受国内玩家好评。

到了《狂热运输 3》，制作组依然保持着开阔视野。战役故事从 1906 年的美国新奥尔良开始，玩家需要帮助这座受飓风侵袭的城市重现生机，顺利举办狂欢节庆典。之后，玩家还会前往 1920 年的意大利，建设穿越阿尔卑斯山脉的铁路；接下来是帮助 20 世纪末的菲律宾改善交通基础设施；在 2015 年，致力于让澳大利亚阿德莱德实现交通运输网络的现代化。最后，玩家将来到 2033 年的日本种子岛，运输必需物资，协助日本顺利完成该国历史上首次载人登月任务。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-63605nD.jpg
前几个战役对于初次接触该系列的玩家比较友好，其指引清晰，玩家按照提示逐步操作即可。但中后期战役复杂度明显上升，难度曲线不够平滑。此外，每个战役都有三个评分等级，顺利过关并不困难，想追求全三星通关则需要稍微费些工夫，每个战役附带的特殊奖励也给了玩家额外动力。
遗憾的是，本作目前只有 8 个战役，规模略逊于前作，且部分战役任务结构相对简单，让玩家有意犹未尽之感，期待制作组能在后续更新中完善这一部分。
今年 9 月，我去参观了东京电玩展（TGS），出于多种因素，我选择住在距离主会场所在的千叶县千叶市约 1 小时车程的东京江户川区。入住当天，我意外发现酒店周围有一座东京地铁博物馆，其于 1986 年开馆，成人票 220 日元（约合人民币 9 元），当即决定返程前最后一天上午过去转转。
地铁博物馆最吸引人的可能是每天 4 次的地铁模型表演，每到固定时间点，观众们就会围拢在巨大的透明玻璃罩旁，一边听着旁白介绍东京地铁的发展历程，一边欣赏里面的列车模型在错综复杂的道路网中穿梭。那时我意识到，几乎所有模拟游戏都会面临一个难题：如何处理现实世界的复杂性。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-73627jm.png
试想，在交通模拟游戏中建设一条地铁线路时，倘若要经历前期规划、协调各工种，甚至操作盾构机等一切现实中所必须的环节，对于开发者和玩家双方都会是一场噩梦。从游戏机制设计的角度来看，处理现实的复杂性大致可以等同于如何做减法以增强可玩性。
Urban Games 及众多模拟游戏开发商对此给出了一套答案：突出模拟对象的地位；重视结果而非过程。对于前者，我们可以在《狂热运输》系列中感受到，运输成为了推动城市发展的核心动力，也是解决诸多问题的唯一手段；对于后者，玩家需要关注的重点并非线路如何建设，而是线路运行所造成的影响。在此基础上，开发团队又持续在结果一侧做出创新，不断用新机制告诉玩家：运输对游戏世界的影响是真实而有力的。

经过十年发展，《狂热运输》系列已经跻身交通运输模拟品类的第一梯队。《狂热运输 3》目前的中文本地化还略有瑕疵，部分翻译可能会影响玩家对游戏的理解；当游戏进入中后期，交通线路变得十分复杂后，中低配置机器运行起来或许会较为吃力，优化方面尚有进步空间。但整体来看，本作在发售初期就已经有了较高完成度。相比前作，游戏的教学引导更为细致，对于新手玩家，它无疑是体验《狂热运输》系列、乃至整个品类的优秀选项，系列老玩家也可以从新机制和新挑战中找到属于自己的乐趣。当列车满载乘客在野外飞速穿行时，适时地切换至第一人称视角，敲击键盘按几下喇叭，看着周围的美景从眼前掠过，那可能会是《狂热运输 3》给玩家最好的回馈。

news.title: GTA 6 粉丝称 Rockstar 只因为他们提出了好意而给他们寄了一张海报
news.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – an

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/gta-6-cover-art-1791589629353.jpg
A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through.

Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community.
"A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room.

"Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil."

You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues.

"This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this."

"​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team."

There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. While we wait to learn more about the next Grand Theft Auto game ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, you can check out IGN's recent interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson . You can also read about what Nintendo had to say about the chances of seeing GTA 6 on Switch 2 , some recently revealed radio stations , and even a batch of new screenshots .

news.title: 让我们都高兴吧，这款 AAA 扫雷游戏不是真实的
news.summary: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes. Now there's a Tr

content.v: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes. Now there's a Triple-A Minesweeper parody that offers a hilarious look at what a Minesweeper update might look like.

The Triple-A Minesweeper was created by writer and programmer Mike Lacher, and it's fully playable as a browser game on his site . Aside from the intentionally pretentious title cards touting the involvement of Unreal Engine, Nvidia, Bink Video, and Wwise, Triple A Minesweeper looks and plays almost exactly like the regular Minesweeper.

However, the best way to enjoy this parody is by simply not doing anything at all. The main character, "Sweeper," will sit around and repeat things like, "I gotta sweep these mines," while receiving calls from newly created characters in the game. Lacher seems to have taken his inspiration from Grand Theft Auto 5, Metal Gear Solid, and even Cyberpunk 2077.

Among the callers are Nora, a potential love interest for Sweeper. Additionally, an underworld figure called The Don repeatedly calls for Sweeper to head down to his club while hinting at the latter's sinister past in Singapore. Meanwhile, the chipper DJ Dan celebrates Sweeper's efforts on behalf of New Dawn City.

In another amusing touch, Sweeper never acknowledges any of the other characters and keeps repeating the same lines over and over. It is possible to complete the game, which triggers a twist ending that probably wasn't that difficult to predict.
Although Lacher leaves the parody on that note, it would have been even funnier if the game's coda mentioned that Triple-A Minesweeper flopped and cost Microsoft hundreds of millions of dollars.

Microsoft hasn't done too much with Minesweeper in the past few years, although it was added to Microsoft Teams as a playable game. The company has also previously created a Minesweeper-themed ugly Christmas sweater .

news.title: 《最终幻想 7 启示录》：我玩了早期游戏的新片段，有一场 Boss 战 | IGN 预览
news.summary: While our earlier previews described a giant open-world game absolutely chock-full of activities, it was nice

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/ff7r-1791586715240.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

We’re about six months out from Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and while that doesn’t seem like a huge wait, the anticipation to play the final chapter of the FF7 remake is palpable, especially since the first chapter dropped six(!) years ago now. We’ve also had the chance to go hands-on with Revelation before, and while the first couple previews were focused on flying around the open world in the Highwind, I got to play a much more linear slice at New York Comic Con.

My demo opened up early in Chapter 1, when the party arrives at the North Crater, and it starts a linear path to the center of the giant hole. In both of the previews we’ve done already, IGN’s Michael Higham and Logan Plant both described Final Fantasy VII Revelation as this massive and overwhelming experience, but this first chapter felt more like walking into a late-game dungeon to fight a massive boss.

Even my party members felt like late-game versions of themselves, fully decked out in Materia and equipment. But it’s important to keep in mind that this is just an early demo, so the balance could totally change before Revelation comes out in April.

But before I actually started wandering into the depths of the crater, I couldn’t help myself in digging through the menus a bit – after all, that’s half the fun of RPGs, right? Clicking into the Materia menu, there’s actually a new way you can level it up, rather than slowly absorbing AP as you kill stuff. There are now Materia fragments, each of which you can consume to add one AP ratio to your Materia.

The remake’s third part didn’t really explain how I was supposed to gather these fragments, but I did start with 200 of them, so I just shoved all of them into my Fire Materia, which got it about a third of a level. I’m not sure I’d just dump them willy-nilly like that in the full game, because I’m not sure how rare they’ll be, but in a short 30-minute demo, what do I have to lose?

The Item Transmuter has also returned from Rebirth, but crucially, gathering the materials for it should be much less of a pain. The auto-loot option that, for some reason, you had to beat the campaign to unlock in Rebirth is just enabled by default in Revelation. I was able to just run through the level and hoover up crafting materials without mashing the triangle button. That’s a huge improvement.

After I was done poking around in the menus, I started to dive deeper into the crater, and it was gorgeous. Regardless of what I’m playing, there’s just something about levels with ice and crystals that always blows my mind, and delving through this crystalline labyrinth never ceases to amaze me – and I wasn’t even playing on the ‘Graphics’ optimization mode. Both Remake and Rebirth looked incredible, though, so it’s not surprising that Revelation is carrying that forward.

But even though I was wandering starstruck through the crater, it wasn’t long before I ran into a group of monsters. The default party in the demo was Cloud, Cid, and Vincent, and of course I immediately swapped over to the new characters to see how they play. Cid immediately stood out. He has this rhythmic quality to his combat, where after one or two standard attacks, you wait for him to be wrapped in this weird blue mist, and then attack again to unleash a stronger attack. And those stronger attacks seem really strong, staggering a standard enemy almost immediately.

I’ve already written about how Game Director Naoki Hamaguchi is going to make the platinum trophy easier to unlock . And it seems like that approach has carried over to combat. I was able to just melt through standard enemies without much thought. There were even larger enemies that spawned in with little mini-cutscenes, and I was able to dispatch them with just a couple of ATB abilities. Again, this is the first chapter, so it’s a little early to really get a feeling for how difficult the game will be when it opens up.

That difficulty (or lack thereof) made testing the new FITS system tricky. I wasn’t able to move FITS jobs around, but Cloud was assigned the Summoner job, and at the cost of one segment of the ATB meter, I was able to summon Ifrit, Shiva, or Titan to enhance my attacks. It was cool seeing some of my attacks land with explosions of fire or ice, but the real draw to this job, in my eyes, is the Synergy attacks each summon has.

Synergy attacks work just like they do in Rebirth and Remake, where you have to use abilities to fill up a little bar. Use enough of them on specific characters and you unlock powerful abilities. The appeal to the summons’ synergy attacks, though, is that I only had to build up ATB on one character to use them, which should make it a lot easier to just churn through them. But most enemies died before I was able to use enough abilities to get to the Synergy ability.

As I get deeper into the crater, I start running into Sephiroth clones – a ton of them – until Cloud has one of his signature visions of Sephiroth. I won’t go into too much detail on the particular nature of Sephiroth’s taunts here in the crater, but if you’ve played Final Fantasy VII on the PS1, you probably have a pretty good idea of what he’s saying.

Eventually, creatures start fusing with the Sephiroth clones to create even more monstrous enemies, until I end up face-to-face with Gigas. And, unlike a lot of the smaller enemies before this, I was able to work up to one of Cloud’s synergy attacks with Ifrit, which ended up being a sort of fusion of the summon’s classic Hellfire attack with Cloud’s sword. However, before the animation finished, Gigas died. But, you know, we’re getting there.

After facing a couple of subsequent enemies, I finally got to a whole crowd of Sephiroth clones surrounding a purple glow of some sort. A cutscene played, and, again, I’ll spare you the details, but it ended with Jenova Deathmourner hatching from one of the clones. Finally, something that can actually put up a fight!

The boss fight plays out pretty similarly to other Jenova battles throughout the series, only this time the tentacles that spawn and make the boss invincible breathe fire. The fight is comprised of three phases, and so I was finally able to actually use multiple synergy abilities – Cid and Vincent, along with Cloud and Shiva. And they’re just as bombastic as they are in Rebirth.

Eventually, after three phases of dodging fire and chopping down tentacles, the boss died and the demo was over. I would have liked the combat to be a bit more difficult, but it is still very early in the game, and there is likely going to be a lot of balance tuning as Final Fantasy VII Revelation gets closer to launch.

Finally, while our earlier previews described a giant open-world game absolutely chock-full of activities, it was nice to see that the story-intense linear bits are still there, and just as dramatic as they were in the first two games. Final Fantasy VII Revelation will ultimately be the conclusion to this massive remake trilogy, and I can just tell that some of the content that was maybe a bit rushed in the original PlayStation game is going to be massive.

news.title: Blumhouse 与 MatPat 合作制作《阿曼达冒险家》电影，确认更多独立恐怖游戏改编即将推出2026 年纽约会展
news.summary: Blumhouse Productions has partnered with YouTube star Matthew ‘MatPat’ Patrick to create a series of movies ba

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/05/amandathumb-1762382499399.png
Blumhouse Productions has partnered with YouTube star Matthew ‘MatPat’ Patrick to create a series of movies based on viral indie horror games, and Amanda the Adventurer is first on the docket.
Representatives from Blumhouse and MatPat confirmed this partnership at New York Comic Con 2026, where they said the YouTuber has “a few projects in the works” with the studio.

“I am proud to announce that I’m working with Blumhouse to launch some new movies. I am taking some of my all-time favorite indie games and horror channels from the interwebs and partnering with Blumhouse to bring them to the big screen,” MatPat said at the panel.

The first of these is Amanda the Adventurer, a first-person, puzzle-solving indie horror game that sees the player character unravel an unsettling mystery involving a low-budget animated children’s show of the same name.
MatPat announced that he and Blumhouse are currently in talks with writers and directors, saying they’re “actually moving fast” to get this project made.
“It’s horror with heart. Amanda is this horrifying but tragic character. It asks the question, ‘Can you trust the media being put in front of your kids?’” he said.

This is the latest YouTuber-led film project to hit the news after Sean ‘Jacksepticeye’ McLoughlin revealed he was at the helm of an animated Bloodborne movie . And earlier this year, YouTube star Mark ‘Markiplier’ Fischbach stunned moviegoers with his self-funded horror movie Iron Lung , an adaptation of an indie horror game of the same name.

Indie horror games have always had a strong audience online, and it seems that major studios are finally taking notice — especially after the success of Kane Parson’s Backrooms earlier this year. The film was such a hit that other creepypasta movies were greenlit in short order, including adaptations of The Mandela Catalogue , Siren Head , and even The SCP Foundation.

Given the viral nature of Amanda the Adventurer, there’s a few good guesses as to what movies MatPat and Blumhouse are cooking up next. Probably all one needs to do is look at CoryxKenshin’s YouTube channel — could a Puppet Combo movie be on the way? (Nun Massacre would be wild to see in a theater.)

For more New York Comic Con news, check out our hub of everything major announced at the convention's Marvel panel, as well as a new Avatar: The Last Airbender show and our interview with Daredevil star Charlie Cox.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/10/marvel-mtg-blogroll-1791592739050.jpg

Wizards of the Coast just announced Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny , its latest Marvel set in a New York Comic Con panel. This is the third Marvel collaboration for the card game, but where the first two were about presenting super heroes as they already exist in Marvel canon, Wizards of the Coast was able to cook up its own storyline for Darkhold Destiny.

The set revolves around the likes of Doctor Strange, Thor and Ghost Rider, all trying to work against Hela and Dormammu invading the multiverse. It's a much better thematic fit for Magic: The Gathering, and the early cards have introduced new mechanics like Vengeance, which is like the Adventure mechanic introduced in Throne of Eldraine, but evil .

Even though there was a lot of information in this panel, the set doesn't come out until April 8th next year, so there are still plenty of details that WotC is holding close to its chest. And, keep in mind that there are still two more Universes Beyond sets coming next year that we don't know anything about.

news.title: 分析师称《战争机器：E-Day》首周销量预计仅为 23 万份
news.summary: Xbox console exclusive Gears of War: E-Day is reportedly off to a soft start after reaching an estimated 230,0

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/07/gears-of-war-e-day-xbox-console-exclusive-1780874341784.png
Xbox console exclusive Gears of War: E-Day is reportedly off to a soft start after reaching an estimated 230,000 copies sold in its first week.

The alleged sales update arrived from Alinea Analytics' head of marketing analysis, Rhys Elliott, who shared early data for the Gears prequel on X/Twitter. After arriving via early access last week (its full launch arrived this past Tuesday), Gears of War: E-Day has reportedly moved just 230,000 copies across PC and Xbox devices.

Steam sales account for 168,000 of that number, with Xbox sales, including both console and PC, totaling just 62,000. These numbers, which are unofficial figures that have not been backed by Microsoft in any official capacity and should be taken with a grain of salt, are low for the game leading the charge on Xbox's refocus toward exclusive games, as players shift their attention from purchasing the base experience to dipping their toes in with Game Pass.

Game Pass is seemingly to blame for its performance related to raw copies sold on Xbox-supported devices, with Elliott saying the subscription service is "cannibalising much of the premium revenue." While that's not to say Gears of War: E-Day is having trouble garnering attention – Alinea estimated that 1.7 million players have accessed the game via Game Pass – the data does suggest that players are far more interested in access through their subscriptions rather than outright owning a copy.

Of the nearly 2 million to launch Gears of War: E-Day through Game Pass, 722,000 users are believed to have paid the extra $30 to upgrade to its Premium Edition to unlock early access. Revenue earned through the Xbox ecosystem reportedly amounted to $27 million, with total earnings reaching about $37 million. How exactly Gears of War: E-Day may have factored into revenue earned through new and returning Game Pass subscriptions is currently unclear.

"While E-Day is a sublime game (it's made my top 10), these are soft numbers for a flagship when Xbox badly needs revenue wins," Elliott said. "E-Day sold 62K copies on Xbox against 722K Premium upgrades, so for every one copy sold on Xbox, nearly 12 Game Pass upgrades were sold. The $70 premium SKU is – functionally – dead on Xbox. In a world without day-one Game Pass, many of these folks would have bought E-Day at $70. They paid $30 for five days early access to something they don’t own. Xbox is, in effect, charging its most valuable customers the least, based on a hangover from a tried-and-exhausted strategy from a previous administration."

The idea that Game Pass has negatively affected standalone sales is something Microsoft has seemingly been internally aware of before, with 2023 documents related to the Activision Blizzard merger noting a decline in base game sales in the first year after a title is added to the service. The Xbox company told IGN at the time that the model "offers gamers and game creators more choice and opportunity in how they discover, experience, and deliver games."

While Microsoft has yet to confirm official sales data, and it's unclear how Gears of War: E-Day may have driven new Game Pass subscriptions, slow sales could sour an otherwise successful launch. The Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago-led prequel emerged with strong reviews from both fans and critics, with IGN's early review, which covered only the campaign mode, awarding a 9/10 .

Earlier this week, The Coalition studio head Mike Crump said Gears of War: E-Day is a "natural choice to be" an Xbox exclusive . He also addressed concerns around potential layoffs at the studio , while promising that the next installment in the series won't take nearly as long to make.
